data.title: [YouPass Collect] - Satisfaction Levels of Full-Time and Part-Time Students About University Library Services

questions.title: The charts below show the results of a survey conducted by a university library to find out the opinions of full-time and part-time students about its services. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
questions.content_writing: The charts below show the results of a survey conducted by a university library to find out the opinions of full-time and part-time students about its services. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
questions.instruction:
HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT BÀI

IELTS Writing Task 1 - Satisfaction Levels of Full-Time and Part-Time Students About University Library Services

 

1. Giải thích đề

  • Giới thiệu dạng Pie Charts
  • Đề bài Satisfaction Levels of Full-Time and Part-Time Students About University Library Services yêu cầu mô tả kết quả khảo sát mức độ hài lòng của sinh viên toàn thời gian (full-time) và bán thời gian (part-time) về 2 dịch vụ thư viện: IT support và opening hours.
  • Bạn nên học cách tả số liệu 'tương đối' & paraphrase cấu trúc câu trước khi viết bài → đây là kỹ năng viết vô cùng quan trọng để dùng trong cả bài viết.
 

2. Định hướng viết Introduction

  • Nội dung: Paraphrase với các dữ kiện chính là: mức độ hài lòng - sinh viên full-time và part-time - 2 dịch vụ thư viện (IT support và opening hours)
  • Học cách viết Introduction cho tất cả các bài dạng Pie Charts ở đây bạn nhé → Cách viết Introduction dạng PIE

 

3. Định hướng viết Overview

Theo Logical Framework©, với dạng đề không thay đổi theo thời gian, chúng mình sẽ đề cập đến 2 thông tin chính:
  • Differences: Cả hai nhóm sinh viên đều rất hài lòng với opening hours, nhưng ý kiến về IT support lại phân hóa rõ rệt — đặc biệt part-time students có mức độ không hài lòng rất cao.
  • Main features: Nhìn chung, full-time students hài lòng hơn part-time students về cả 2 dịch vụ được khảo sát.
 

4. Phân chia BODY rõ ràng

Theo Logical Framework©, chúng mình sẽ chia đoạn thân bài một cách rõ ràng, bằng cách gom các hạng mục có sự tương đồng, cụ thể như sau:

BODY 1: IT support

Theo Logical Framework©, chúng mình sẽ định hướng các bạn viết từng bước ở BODY 1 như sau:
  • (Step 1) So sánh mức "Very" giữa 2 nhóm (đa số sinh viên full-time cảm thấy rất hài lòng, chiếm 55%, so với chỉ 1/5 sinh viên part-time)
  • (Step 2) So sánh mức "Not at all" giữa 2 nhóm (gần một nửa sinh viên part-time không hài lòng, ở mức 45%, cao gấp hơn 3 lần so với full-time students ở mức 13%)
  • (Step 3) So sánh mức "Quite" giữa 2 nhóm (tỷ lệ khá tương đồng: 32% sinh viên full-time và 35% sinh viên part-time)

BODY 2: Opening hours

Theo Logical Framework©, chúng mình sẽ định hướng các bạn viết từng bước ở BODY 1 như sau:
  • (Step 1) So sánh mức "Very" giữa 2 nhóm (khoảng 2/3 sinh viên full-time và gần 3/4 sinh viên part-time)
  • (Step 2) So sánh mức "Quite" giữa 2 nhóm (32% sinh viên full-time cảm thấy khá hai lòng, cao hơn sinh viên part-time khoảng 9%, ở mức 23%)
  • (Step 3) So sánh mức "Not at all" giữa 2 nhóm (mức không hài lòng rất thấp ở cả 2 nhóm: chỉ 1% sinh viên full-time và 5% sinh viên part-time)
 

5. Gợi ý Paraphrasing

Khi muốn diễn đạt "levels of satisfaction", chúng ta có những cách paraphrase như sau
  • levels of contentment
  • satisfaction levels
Ví dụ:
  • Overall, while both student groups expressed high levels of contentment with the library's opening hours, opinions on IT support were far more divided, with part-time students being notably less satisfied.
  • As for the library's opening hours, satisfaction levels were considerably higher for both groups.

writing_logical_frame.name: Introduction
writing_logical_frame.value: The four pie charts illustrate the levels of satisfaction among full-time and part-time university students regarding two library services, namely IT support and opening hours.

writing_logical_frame.name: Overview
writing_logical_frame.value: Overall, while both student groups expressed high levels of contentment with the library's opening hours, opinions on IT support were far more divided, with part-time students being notably less satisfied. In addition, full-time students were generally happier with the services provided than their part-time counterparts.

writing_logical_frame.name: Body 1
writing_logical_frame.value: Regarding IT support, a clear majority of full-time students were very happy with this service, at 55%, compared to only a fifth of part-time students. Conversely, nearly half of part-time attendees reported being not at all satisfied, which was over three times higher than the figure for full-time students, at just 13%. Meanwhile, the proportion of students who were quite happy was relatively similar between the two groups, at 32% and 35% for full-time and part-time students, respectively.

writing_logical_frame.name: Body 2
writing_logical_frame.value: As for the library's opening hours, satisfaction levels were considerably higher for both groups. Approximately two-thirds and nearly three-quarters of full-time and part-time students, respectively, were very pleased with the current schedule. A further 32% of full-time students expressed moderate satisfaction, which was 9 percentage points higher than the corresponding figure for part-time attendees. Notably, dissatisfaction was minimal in both cases, with only 1% of full-time and 5% of part-time students reporting that they were not at all happy with this service.

1/ Chart Description:

Chart type: Pie charts (4 pie charts)
Title: "How happy are you with the IT support offered?" / "How happy are you with our current opening hours?"
Time period: N/A (survey, no specific year)
Units: Percentage (%)
Axes: N/A (pie charts)
Categories/Groups: 2 services (IT support, Opening hours) × 2 student types (Full-time, Part-time) × 3 satisfaction levels (Very, Quite, Not at all)

IT Support:
Satisfaction Level, Full-Time Students, Part-Time Students
Very, 55%, 20%
Quite, 32%, 35%
Not at all, 13%, 45%
Opening Hours:
Satisfaction Level, Full-Time Students, Part-Time Students
Very, 67%, 72%
Quite, 32%, 23%
Not at all, 1%, 5%
